item.title: St Helens reveals Gamble Building vision
item.description: CGIs providing insight on the proposed extension and internal refurbishment and repurposing of the historic Victoria Square building have been released. The post St Helens reveals Gamble Building vision appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: David Lloyd secures Wirral Waters green light
item.description: The premium health and fitness brand has the go-ahead to develop six acres of Bidston Dock, where it has plans for a 56,000 sq ft complex. The post David Lloyd secures Wirral Waters green light appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Story appeals delay to £80m Camelot regeneration
item.description: An inquiry will be held in May to determine whether or not the housebuilder’s plan to deliver 350 homes at the former theme park can go ahead after Chorley Council failed to make a decision in good time. The post Story appeals delay to £80m Camelot regeneration appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Federal fuels for Northern rollout
item.description: Seeking to gobble up further market share in the brunch segment, the café group has secured £3m from private equity backer Foresight to support a further 18 sites by 2030. The post Federal fuels for Northern rollout appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Davos nudges skyline-altering Liverpool masterplan towards submission
item.description: Four buildings between 30 and 50 storeys and another rising to 60 make up plans for the redevelopment of King Edward Triangle, arguably the city’s most ambitious pipeline scheme. The post Davos nudges skyline-altering Liverpool masterplan towards submission appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: SPD drawn up for 1,550 Northern Gateway homes
item.description: Rochdale Council and Bury Council are due to sign off a draft framework for the 242-acre Simister Bowlee area over the next few weeks, with a public consultation to follow soon after. The post SPD drawn up for 1,550 Northern Gateway homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: THING OF THE WEEK

item.title: Select completes 33-storey Manchester tower
item.description: The 477-apartment One Port Street is the developer’s largest scheme to date. The post Select completes 33-storey Manchester tower appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Initial Viridis blocks clear BSR hurdle in Fallowfield
item.description: The first two higher-risk buildings within the consortium’s £400m University of Manchester student living scheme have secured Gateway 2 approval from the Building Safety Regulator. The post Initial Viridis blocks clear BSR hurdle in Fallowfield appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Work starts on first phase of £500m Wythenshawe regen
item.description: Main contractor Kier is targeting a 2027 completion for a 30,000 sq ft culture hub within the Civic shopping centre being delivered for Manchester City Council and its development partner Muse. The post Work starts on first phase of £500m Wythenshawe regen appeared first on Place North West.
